heroHeadline: US-Led Coalition to Complete Kurdistan Withdrawal by September 30 as Western Military Presence Ends
heroSubtitle: The US-led coalition is set to complete its withdrawal from Iraq's Kurdistan region by September 30, finalising the drawdown of Western military forces across northern Iraq. The exit follows the September 25 handover of the US Diplomatic Support Centre at Baghdad airport to Iraqi authorities. All four major Iraqi airports have suspended Iranian carrier flights under new US aviation sanctions, and PM Ali al-Zaidi used his UN General Assembly address to pitch an 'invest with Iraq' economic vision. Turkey has separately agreed to hand over the disputed Bashiqa-Zelikan base near Mosul to Iraqi federal control.
